messages.subject: ROI selection and filtering
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to subset data using ROI designations. I was sucessful in doing this once and then have run into several errors. 

For example: I hand picked six regions of intrests R1:R6 and then used three of them (R1,R2,R3) for the first factor. 
Velocity <- makeFactor (High = R1, Medium = R2, Low = R3)
LM$v <- Velocity

Then I was able to reduce the data by using:
v_Data <- subsetPixels(LM, region ==  v)

This worked intially and I was able to run several statistical analyses on the data. However, when I went to preform this procedure again using the data and regions I ran into this error : 

  

I have tried remaking the regions, factors, and intial data sets so that nothing would overlap and I still run into similar errors. 

Any help would be appreciated!
Thank you for your time,

Nolan
